material.title: Acme Motors unveils the Acme One, a 500 km electric SUV starting at $39,900
material.bodyOriginal: Acme Motors today unveiled the Acme One, an electric SUV with a 500 km WLTP range and an 800V architecture that charges from 10% to 80% in 18 minutes. It starts at $39,900 and deliveries begin in Q1 2027.
